scope: Atomic legacy holding adoption without synthetic trades; explicit unknown sellability/date; final-row knowledge guards and stale BUY preconditions; migration0030.

changed_domain_coverage.scope: Two changed Domain files only; not overall project/Domain-suite coverage

limits: Local development validation only. No live broker/order, production registration/backfill/deployment, main merge, push, RC/CI/S6 or Owner M1/M2/M3 qualification.

Existing rows retain compatibility True flags; these describe existing local values and do not certify broker provenance. Newly adopted legacy holdings explicitly have both flags False, external null/unknown, and no synthetic BUY.

Actual broker-fill preservation, explicit baseline inclusion, durable projection reconciliation/retry and authoritative sellability remain next ASH03 work. Historical PIT, current quotes and local sellability must not become prerequisites for recording actual fills.

Once False rows exist, code that ignores the new flags is not an approved code-only rollback. Reverse migration refuses while either flag is False; freezing writes and an audited reconciliation/rollback plan are required before an older implementation can be considered.

Deterministic ORM interleaving tests use one connection and real stored rows. They verify flags and refusal decisions, not two-connection PostgreSQL lock stress. Native UOW/migration checks are separate evidence.

Closed legacy source rows are read before entering the new context; if closed rows may be reassigned/reopened concurrently, a locked source re-read remains a follow-up. Reviewed open-portfolio adoption is atomic.

Existing missing-price cost fallback and unused simulated response serializer IntegerField/fractional-share mismatch remain disclosed observations, not source-freshness or fractional-share certification.
Offline migrate_account_ledger is unchanged and is not covered by the new read-adoption guarantees. Historical numeric/date values were not rewritten.
SDK real local HTTP tests run in the separate 404-test pack without the Domain network fence. The fenced HTTP/UOW/Domain slices reported zero rejected application socket/DNS attempts.
next: ASH03 actual broker-fill fact preservation, explicit balance inclusion and durable reconciliation; M1/M2/M3 production acceptance remains open.
